scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: A person who drives or has care and control of a vehicle on a HIGHWAY.

A common and public highway, street, avenue, parkway, driveway, square, place, bridge, viaduct or trestle, any part of which is intended for or used by the general public for the passage of vehicles, including the area between the lateral property lines.
The part of the HIGHWAY that is improved, designed or ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, not including the SHOULDER.
The part of the HIGHWAY beside the ROADWAY that is not ordinarily used for vehicular traffic.
When prohibited, the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when standing temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading merchandise or passengers.
When prohibited, the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers.

When prohibited, the halting of a vehicle, even momentarily, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or a traffic control sign or signal.
The area embraced within the prolongation or connection of the lateral curb lines, or if none, of the lateral boundary lines, of two or more HIGHWAYS that join one another at an angle.

The part of a HIGHWAY at an INTERSECTION included within the connections of the lateral lines of the sidewalks on opposite sides of the HIGHWAY, or any part of a ROADWAY distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by signs or by lines or other markings on the surface.
A permit issued by the Province of Ontario (or a recognised equivalent) to a person with a disability, displayed in the vehicle to allow parking in a designated accessible parking space.
A high-speed, multi-lane, controlled-access HIGHWAY such as a 400-series highway.

rules.title: Rural roads: park off the roadway when practicable
rules.when: on a HIGHWAY outside a city, town or village AND it is practicable to PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle off the ROADWAY
rules.action: PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle on the ROADWAY
rules.unless: the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid temporarily leaving it on the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN on a HIGHWAY outside a city, town or village AND it is practicable to PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle off the ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle on the ROADWAY, UNLESS the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid temporarily leaving it on the ROADWAY.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say what makes parking off the roadway practicable

rules.note: Highway Traffic Act s.170(1)-(2). The exact geographic scope (outside cities, towns, villages / built-up areas) is from memory and should be checked.

rules.title: Rural roads: clear view of 125 m when roadway parking unavoidable
rules.when: on a HIGHWAY outside a city, town or village AND it is not practicable to PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle off the ROADWAY
rules.action: PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle on the ROADWAY
rules.unless: a clear view of the vehicle and of the ROADWAY for at least 125 metres beyond the vehicle can be obtained from a distance of at least 125 metres from the vehicle in each direction OR the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid temporarily leaving it on the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN on a HIGHWAY outside a city, town or village AND it is not practicable to PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle off the ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STAND or STOP the vehicle on the ROADWAY, UNLESS a clear view of the vehicle and of the ROADWAY for at least 125 metres beyond the vehicle can be obtained from a distance of at least 125 metres from the vehicle in each direction OR the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid temporarily leaving it on the ROADWAY.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say what makes parking off the roadway impracticable

rules.note: Highway Traffic Act s.170(1)(b).

rules.title: Never park on the travelled section of a highway
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: PARK on the travelled section of the HIGHWAY, and MUST instead drive off the ROADWAY onto the SHOULDER
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK on the travelled section of the HIGHWAY, and MUST instead drive off the ROADWAY onto the SHOULDER.
rules.note: Official MTO Driver's Handbook wording; applies where a shoulder is available.

rules.title: Do not interfere with traffic or snow clearing
rules.when: leaving a vehicle on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle in a manner that interferes with the movement of traffic or the clearing of snow from the HIGHWAY
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a vehicle on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle in a manner that interferes with the movement of traffic or the clearing of snow from the HIGHWAY.
rules.penalty: The vehicle may be removed and impounded at the owner's expense.
rules.note: Highway Traffic Act s.170(12); police or authorised officers may remove the vehicle under s.170(15).

rules.title: Do not block traffic or create a hazard
rules.when: choosing a place to PARK
rules.action: PARK where the vehicle would block traffic or create a hazard
rules.statement: WHEN choosing a place to PARK, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK where the vehicle would block traffic or create a hazard.

vague_terms.explanation: what counts as a hazard is not defined

rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; municipal by-laws add further local restrictions.

rules.title: Fire hydrant: 3 metres
rules.when: within 3 metres of a fire hydrant
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN within 3 metres of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: Listed in the MTO Driver's Handbook; enforced by municipal by-laws, which set fines and may use a larger distance.

rules.title: No parking on a curve
rules.when: on a curve
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN on a curve, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: No parking on or near the top of a hill
rules.when: on or near the top of a hill
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN on or near the top of a hill, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.

vague_terms.term: near the top of a hill

rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: No parking on a bridge
rules.when: on a bridge
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN on a bridge, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: No parking on a crosswalk
rules.when: on a CROSSWALK
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN on a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; also prohibited by municipal by-laws.

rules.title: Intersection without signals: 9 metres
rules.when: within 9 metres of an INTERSECTION that is not controlled by traffic lights
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN within 9 metres of an INTERSECTION that is not controlled by traffic lights, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; municipal by-laws may set different distances.

rules.title: Signalized intersection: 15 metres
rules.when: within 15 metres of an INTERSECTION controlled by traffic lights
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 metres of an INTERSECTION controlled by traffic lights, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; municipal by-laws may set different distances.

rules.title: Railway crossing: 15 metres
rules.when: within 15 metres of the nearest rail of a level railway crossing
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 metres of the nearest rail of a level railway crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: Public entrances: 6 metres
rules.when: within 6 metres of a public entrance to a hotel, theatre or public hall AND the building is open to the public
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN within 6 metres of a public entrance to a hotel, theatre or public hall AND the building is open to the public, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; recalled from memory, check the current edition.

rules.title: Do not block a lane or driveway
rules.when: in front of a lane or driveway
rules.action: PARK so as to block the lane or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN in front of a lane or driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK so as to block the lane or driveway.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; enforced by municipal by-laws.

rules.title: Do not hide traffic signs or signals
rules.when: near a traffic sign or traffic signal
rules.action: PARK where the vehicle would hide the sign or signal from other road users
rules.statement: WHEN near a traffic sign or traffic signal, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK where the vehicle would hide the sign or signal from other road users.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: No parking in a bicycle lane
rules.when: at a designated bicycle lane
rules.action: PARK or STOP in the bicycle lane
rules.statement: WHEN at a designated bicycle lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STOP in the bicycle lane.
rules.note: Stated in MTO handbook guidance on sharing the road; legal prohibition and fines come from municipal by-laws (e.g. Toronto) and vary.

rules.title: Freeway shoulder: emergencies only
rules.when: on a FREEWAY
rules.action: STOP on the SHOULDER
rules.statement: WHEN on a FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP on the SHOULDER, UNLESS there is an emergency.

vague_terms.explanation: what qualifies as an emergency is not defined

rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook freeway guidance; regulatory signs on many provincial highways also prohibit stopping except in emergencies.

rules.title: No Parking sign
rules.when: in an area governed by a No Parking sign AND within the times shown on the sign
rules.action: PARK
rules.statement: WHEN in an area governed by a No Parking sign AND within the times shown on the sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; stopping briefly to load or unload passengers or merchandise is allowed under the definition of PARK. Fines set by municipal by-laws.

rules.title: No Standing sign
rules.when: in an area governed by a No Standing sign AND within the times shown on the sign
rules.action: STAND
rules.statement: WHEN in an area governed by a No Standing sign AND within the times shown on the sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT STAND.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; stopping only while actually picking up or dropping off passengers is allowed under the definition of STAND.

rules.title: No Stopping sign
rules.when: in an area governed by a No Stopping sign AND within the times shown on the sign
rules.action: STOP
rules.statement: WHEN in an area governed by a No Stopping sign AND within the times shown on the sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; halting to avoid conflict with traffic or on the direction of a police officer or traffic signal is not prohibited stopping.

rules.title: Time-limited parking sign
rules.when: in an area where a sign permits parking for a limited time
rules.action: PARK longer than the time shown on the sign
rules.statement: WHEN in an area where a sign permits parking for a limited time, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK longer than the time shown on the sign.
rules.note: Regulatory sign; fines set by municipal by-laws.

rules.title: Accessible parking spaces
rules.when: at a parking space designated by an accessible parking sign
rules.action: PARK in the space if a valid ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT is displayed in the vehicle AND the permit holder is being transported in the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN at a parking space designated by an accessible parking sign, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PARK in the space if a valid ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT is displayed in the vehicle AND the permit holder is being transported in the vehicle.
rules.penalty: Municipal fines (often several hundred dollars); misuse of a permit can bring fines of up to $5,000 under the HTA regulation.
rules.note: Highway Traffic Act and O. Reg. 581; parking fine amounts are set by municipalities. Force is REQUIREMENT but expressed as MAY ONLY.

rules.title: Facing downhill: wheels toward curb
rules.when: PARKING facing downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels toward the curb or the right SHOULDER
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING facing downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels toward the curb or the right SHOULDER.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; reason given is to keep the vehicle from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail.

rules.title: Facing uphill with curb: wheels to the left
rules.when: PARKING facing uphill AND there is a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the left so that they rest against the curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING facing uphill AND there is a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the left so that they rest against the curb.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: Facing uphill without curb: wheels to the right
rules.when: PARKING facing uphill AND there is no curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels sharply to the right
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING facing uphill AND there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels sharply to the right.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook; keeps the vehicle rolling off the road rather than into traffic.

rules.title: Set the parking brake on a hill
rules.when: PARKING on a hill
rules.action: set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a hill, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook.

rules.title: Open doors only with due precautions
rules.when: the vehicle is on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: open a door of the vehicle without taking due precautions to ensure that doing so will not interfere with the movement of or endanger any other person or vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER or passenger MUST NOT open a door of the vehicle without taking due precautions to ensure that doing so will not interfere with the movement of or endanger any other person or vehicle.
rules.penalty: Fine of $300 to $1,000 and 3 demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: specific checks not stated in law

rules.note: Highway Traffic Act s.165(a); demerit points apply to the driver.

rules.title: Do not leave a door open on the traffic side
rules.when: a door of the vehicle is open on the side available to moving traffic on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers
rules.statement: WHEN a door of the vehicle is open on the side available to moving traffic on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER or passenger MUST NOT leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers.
rules.penalty: Fine of $300 to $1,000 and 3 demerit points.
rules.note: Highway Traffic Act s.165(b).

rules.title: Check for cyclists before opening a door
rules.when: about to open a door after PARKING on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: check mirrors and look over the shoulder for approaching cyclists and other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN about to open a door after PARKING on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST check mirrors and look over the shoulder for approaching cyclists and other traffic.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook guidance on sharing the road with cyclists; exact wording (command vs. advice) uncertain.

rules.title: Signal and check before pulling out
rules.when: moving a parked vehicle from the SHOULDER or curb into traffic
rules.action: first see that the movement can be made safely and, if other traffic may be affected, give a signal
rules.statement: WHEN moving a parked vehicle from the SHOULDER or curb into traffic, the DRIVER MUST first see that the movement can be made safely and, if other traffic may be affected, give a signal.
rules.note: Based on Highway Traffic Act s.142 signalling duties and the handbook; whether s.142 explicitly covers starting from a parked position should be checked.

rules.title: Parallel parking: signal and check traffic
rules.when: about to parallel PARK at the curb
rules.action: check traffic behind, signal the intention to stop and PARK, and stop beside the vehicle ahead of the empty space before reversing into it
rules.statement: WHEN about to parallel PARK at the curb, the DRIVER MUST check traffic behind, signal the intention to stop and PARK, and stop beside the vehicle ahead of the empty space before reversing into it.
rules.note: Summarises the MTO Driver's Handbook parallel-parking steps; the handbook also says to keep checking traffic and finish parallel and close to the curb.

rules.title: Breakdown: get off the road and use hazard lights
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: move the vehicle off the ROADWAY onto the SHOULDER as far as possible and turn on the emergency flashers
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST move the vehicle off the ROADWAY onto the SHOULDER as far as possible and turn on the emergency flashers.
rules.note: MTO Driver's Handbook emergency guidance.
